batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b DW Steyn

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c CL White b JH Kallis

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b SJ Srivastava

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b Bipul Sharma

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b IK Pathan

balls.text: length ball hit over the infield on the leg side and substitute KP Apanna puts in a desperate dive to prevent the boundary. Strangely they run only one run
Bopara wants Irfan on strike and risks a second that is not on as it has gone straight to long-on, and Pandey's flat throw is right by the stumps and a new man now will face the last ball
lovely clean strike, PK misses the yorker slightly and he gets under it and lofts him over long-off
goes for a full and wide delivery but bowls it too wide
slower ball and Irfan is waiting for it, and nicely pulls it over square leg
slower ball, and it beats Bopara who is moving across al the time, will get a leg-bye
and Bopara moves back and way across and gets under a low full toss and gets it over short fine leg - smart batting
moves across the stumps and mows this one to deep midwicket
yorker, hit straight to long-off, and Uthappa fails to collect cleanly a powerful throw from Kohli and gives away an overthrow
slower ball too short, pulled in front of square, Bopara gets a couple
goes for the safe yorker, gives away a single to cover
slower ball gone wrong, ends up a juicy full toss outside off, and he has lofted it over extra cover, easy does it
slower ball on the pads, and he is lucky to get away with a single with the fine leg up
nicely played inside-out, but White makes a superb full-length dive at cover boundary and ends up saving one run, and a lovely throw right over the stumps, making Bopara dive
slower ball outside off, Bopara looks to chip it over extra cover but is beaten
don't tell me this was a plan! another full toss on the pads and he has timed it sweetly straight down deep midwicket's throat. Big wicket, Yuvraj could have taken this innings to an imposing total
full toss on the pads, and Yuvraj doesn't need to be told how to despatch those to the square leg boundary - Steyn dives full length from square leg but can't get a hand to it
yorker and he digs it out for one
Bopara walks down the track and places a high full toss perfectly between long-on and deep midwicket

another solid bouncer, Yuvraj is late into the shot, and the ball swerves away from Uthappa after crossing the batsman, Uthappa does well to get a left hand to it. Billy Bowden delays the bye signal, and by the time he raises his arm Steyn has given Uthappa a dirty look or three
bouncer, gets onto him too fast, and the pull would have been swallowed by mid-off had it been in place
Yuvraj backs away and Steyn follows him with a slower delivery, gets a single to extra cover
yorker outside off, pushed to extra cover for one
slower ball, 107ks, but it is short and he manges to pull it wide of deep square
pushes a full and fast delivery to long-on for a single
nicely tosses-up googly, Yuvraj reads and sweeps against the turn, all along the ground to deep midwicket
goes slightly round arm, and flights it right into the block hole, and Yuvraj drills it back to him
plays it delicately late, off the pads, and works it fine of fine leg, and comes back for two
short, fast, and Bopara is hurried into the pull, gets a single to long-on
gives him the charge again, looks to go inside-out but gets too close to it and hits it to long-off for one. And it's a massive no-ball by the way
Yuviiiiiii! gives him the charge, gets close to the ball, and the googly goes flying into the crowd behind long-on
full delivery, worked across the line for a single
overpitched delivery just outside off and driven down to long-off for one
slower ball, on the pads, hit to square leg
Kallis's quicker bouncer, 138ks, and Yuvi is caught in an awkward spot on the pull but the top edge clears Uthappa with ease
steered to third man to bring Yuvi back on strike
fuller ball, hit to mid-off, Pandey's throw is wild and Uthappa collects it where short third man would be - an extra single there
Kallis tries a bouncer too, and Yuvraj is expecting it! Princely pull shot, comfortable height, and it's deposited into the midwicket stand
backs away and is followed by Steyn, gets a single to long-on
another bouncer, this time it's slower than the one before and Yuvraj gets out of the line
phew! 151Ks bouncer, gets Yuvraj in the back shoulder, he was caught in the headlights here
another slower ball, sliding into the leg side, worked away for one
slower ball, and again uses whatever pace there is on it, to run it fine of third man
makes room, uses Steyn's pace, and cuts him past point - smart batting after being kept quiet last over
flighted on the pads and nicely swept away, square enough of fine leg to beat Vinay Kumar and fetch him four
googly, Bopara is cramped on the pull, but gets a single
straight and fast, 99ks, no room either, defended
flighted around off, bunted into the covers for a single
shorter, quicker 96ks, cuts it away to sweeper-cover
paddled away, from in front of stumps, gets it fine of fine leg
full and straight, 149.4ks, Yuvi moves across the stumps and flicks the first ball he faces - clean stroke, wide of fine leg
drops to cover and runs, and KP gets a bad bounce else this would have been interesting
short, quick, but wide outside off
again he is quick, and there isn't much room, Bopara hits it to cover
back of a length, quick, no room, defended
148ks, and Bopara is beaten by the pace on the square cut
soft end to a dangerous-looking innings, Sanga picks a short ball, pulls it nicely but also picks out Kallis at deep square leg
cut away to sweeper-cover for a single
soft hands this time, and runs hard enough to come back for two before Vinay from long-on can come around and throw
Sanga! makes room, goes deep into the crease and flat-bats a length ball straight, bisecting long-on and long-off
good bouncer, catches him on the front foot, but the top edge falls short of fine leg

drama! Sanga hits it straight to long-on, Bopara wants two but is sent back, VK's throw is at the right end but Uthappa has to come down the wicket to collect it, and goes for the blind flick to try and catch Bopara short. Uthappa misses and Kolhi from short fine dives to prevent five: the ball is headed straight towards the helmet
dabs this to short third man
takes the risk of cutting against the turn, and manages a single wide of short third man
sharp turn, from wide of off to cramping him up
hit softly into the leg side where nobody is in the circle, but KP does the chasing and keeps them down to one
fired into the pads, helped away to short fine
on the pads and worked away for one
and what a lovely lofted shot down the ground, beats long-off easily, just the extension of the arms
Man wins the Man v Boy game! This time Bisla looks to scoop Kumble (seriously?) over short fine, and leaves the stumps exposed, and Kumble nails the off stick with a straight delivery
Bisla makes room and has to contend with a fiery delivery that keeps following him
makes room, places a googly to wide of extra cover for one
an almighty biff here, sees the flighted delivery, stands his ground, and sweeps it between square leg and long-on
Sanga gives him the charge, and has to defend a flat delivery, close to 100ks
sees him come down and flights this generously, Bisla hits it down to long-off, along the ground
guides a full delivery to third man for a single
offcutter, pitched outside leg, turning towards middle and leg, worked away to square leg
dabbed away to third man for one
worked away into the leg side, and they chance Steyn's arm and make it - just
sharp bouncer, 141ks, but dug in a bit too short, beats Uthappa too
looks to cut but it is too close to him, and also keeps chasing him
misfielded by Steen by deep square leg, it was hit nicely with the angle, and Steyn makes good ground to his right but the slight wobble beats his slide
Bisla trying to get out here, makes room and deliberately cuts him in the air. Good thing that he hasn't connected well, because it bounces short of deep point
flat on the pads, and helped away to deep midwicket for one
worked away off the pads for a single
plays across the line of a flighted delivery, is beaten, saved by the fact that the ball didn't turn enough - Hawkeye says it was hitting, but there was no big appeal from Kumble
flat, angling in, worked away between the two men deep on the on side
and Bisla is beaten right away as he steps out of the crease too early, the inside edge hits the pad and he is saved
not the best of his shots, clears his body out of the line, Kallis slips in a slower ball, and Sanga gets the inside half of the bat, but also gets enough power to beat mid-on and go for four
straight delivery this time, no room, Sanga hits it to cover
lovely offcutter, breaks as much as Murali manages it, pitches leg and beats him outside off on the cut
gets a top edge on a premeditated flick over the infield on the leg side, it falls short of the deep fielder
looking to manufacture another shot, making room this time, Kallis stays back of a length, and on the stumps. Bisla hits this one to mid-off
and Bisla starts jumping out of the track soon as he is done sending the telegram stating his intent, and Kallis accordingly bowls it short and beats him
Sanga comes down, Vinay slips in the bouncer, a sharp one, taking him by the surprise and making him sway out of the way in a hurry
short outside off, and he drags it to deep midwicket for one
loose delivery, full on the pads, and all Bisla has to do is get it wide of short fine leg
again looking to turn a back-of-a-length delivery to on, and gets a leading edge that bounces before reaching cover
plays across the line of a straight delivery and misses
gets an inside edge onto the pad as he looks to play it to third man, but steals a single, good calling from Bisla
cracking shot, reeking of disdain, makes room to a back-of-a-length delivery, takes it from middle and leg, and forces it past point
yorker from Steyn, good comeback, dug out with incident
slightly shorter, and again nicely driven but straight to mid-off
poor bowling and good batting, a half-volley on the middle stump and Bisla just meets it with a full face, no power, all timing, and mid-on has no chance
on the pads, and he works it wide of mid-on for a single
and he has been crunched through covers first ball, full and wide and smashed away. Bring it on, says Sanga
Bisla gets a bouncer, and ducks under it easily
slower ball, and he drops it to cover and pinches a single
and PK strays on the pads, asking to be punished, and Sanga obliges by flicking him to square leg
another trademark Sanga shot, punched away square, just enough room for him, and he leaves two men - point and third man - diving in vain
makes room, PK follows him, no room there, and he hits it straight to mid-on
looks to open the face on on but it's too close to him
and follows it up with a bunted single to square leg
and he gets the sparse crowd involved with a trademark languid square-drive, VK gave him the width and he sends it crashing between point and cover

and VK strikes early, what a bowling combination change! the effort ball, quicker than his three previous deliveries, pitches middle and off and makes him play and leaves him enough to take the edge, and Dravid at wide slip is placed perfectly for it
another bottom edge on a Marsh attempt to run it down for a single
back of  a length again, Bisla places it wide of a diving Kallis at midwicket
back of a length, outside off, steered away to third man
tips and runs to cover, and makes sure this is not a maiden
looks to pull this one, but swings over the ball, not short enough for the shot
gets in line this time and defended solidly towards point
massive swing there, pitches leg - maybe even outside - and beats a defensive shot outside off
looks to run a fullish balll down to third man, gets a bottom edge
swing away from Marsh, who lets it go through to Uthappa. PK not happy with the bounce it almost bounces twice before reaching the keeper
finishes this error-filled match with a sweet boundary through extra cover. Bangalore back to what they have become used to - winning
KP jumps across the crease, IKP wants to create some distance, and bowls it way wide outside off

that's the blow that should do it! White has got his eye in, and clears the front leg to smack this length delivery between long-on and long-off. You don't bowl three length deliveries in a row to White
another full toss hit down to long-off, another single
length ball, tailing in, pushed down to long-on for one
full toss, strongly hit down to long-off
pushed down to long-on for a single
low full toss, manages to cramp hi, will be just a single to long-on
and finally somebody has held onto a catch! Uthappa walks down the wicket to send this flying down the ground again, but gets a toe edge through to Bisla. Too late for Punjab?
short ball, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
insult, meet injury! Now comes the clean hit, over extra cover, four more

that's the definitive image of Punjab's night: Sangakkara lying on his face having dropped yet another catch off a full toss that got KP's bat high. Sanga ran from cover backwards, got under it, and somehow let it through, and while tumbling over he kicked it to the boundary
another drop, although this is a tough chance for Sharma running from sweeper-cover to his right. Brings up KP's first IPL fifty
oh wild shot from KP, dances down the track and swings and misses
overpitched, hit powerfully down the ground again, straighter of long-off, comes back for two
full toss down the leg side, and it goes through makeshift Bisla
Crash! Robbie batting like a dream! And Lee is serving him with length balls! gets under this one and goes over midwicket, clean clean strike, 30 rows behind
another yorker, digs it out to third man for one. No appeal this time
yorker outside off, played to short third man for one, and Lee asks for an lbw. Middle of the bat, mate. You must be seeing things
length ball this time, and Uthappa has slapped it into the sight screen, one bounce
what a shot! clean clean strike! No power, no back lift, just one front foot down the wicket and a high-elbowed loft on a low full toss, 10 rows behind long-off
full delivery, nearly a yorker, hit down to long-on for one
flat delivery, waits for it, and places it nicely between long-on and deep midwicket and comes back for two
with that drop, Bopara might have dropped himself out of the team! KP gets too close to this as he is dancing down, and doesn't get the elevation, and Bopara drops a knee-high catch at long-on
another full toss claims a wicket! could be a big wicket! Kohli is looking to send this full toss to Chandigarh but gets the toe end straight to Irfan at deep midwicket
comes down the track again, but Sharma fires it full and straight, the inside edge yields two
but the figures are about to be rearranged! Kohli dances down the track, Sharma pulls it back a bit but Kohli still gets under it and sends it sailing over cow corner
low full toss outside off to counter his movement across, and KP goes with the angle, just wide of extra cover, and it is Bopara's turn this time to let oner slip through at sweeper-cover boundary
hit straight to extra cover, and Sanga's throw is too full for IKP to collect and run Kohli out
slower ball, drags it too short, and Kohli's eyes light up and he nearly takes out a cheerleader behind the cow corner boundary with the pull
moves across again, IKP stays full and wide again, and it is just a single to sweeper-cover
bouncer tried, and Kohli pulls it in front of square
length ball, outside off, and smacked down to long-off but gets just a single
low full toss, hit powerfully again, one bounce to long-off
makes room, Shalabh fires in the yorker, they take a single off the bottom edge

gets Bowden there! Some gratitude for the man who has turned down three lbw appeals! Smacks this length delivery straight, it's a powerful hit and finds Bowden's knee. Strangely no show of pain. He has saved three for Punjab, though
oh Sree! He lets it through his hands at long-on! Kohli has hit this slower ball straight down Sree's throat at long-on and it finds a porous Sreesanth. PK in the Bangalore  dugout claps!
full and wide, stretches to hit it wide of third man, but doesn't come back for two. It's KP's highest IPL score. Ever
good last ball, yorker outside off, beats his attempt to run it down to third man
length ball, punched to sweeper-cover for one
steps down and yorks himself up
shortish and punched away wide of point for two
makes room to find Irfan has followed him, and he flicks it to fine leg for one
walloped down the ground and along the ground, half-volley as a loosener and Kohli finds the sight screen
overpitched and hit powerfully down to long-off
full toss and nicely chipped over extra cover for two
another lbw shout, the best one of the lot, it hits him on the full but still catches him outside the line
KP sets himself up for the big shot as he sees a flighted delivery, but this follows him upon pitching
smashed straight down again, gets Yuvi in the foot, and deflects to the other side of long-off for another couple
comes down the track, gets to the pitch of it, and smacks it down the ground, straight enough of long-off to come back for two
bunted away into the leg side and they push for a second. Two fielders are rushing towards it, and neither gets down, letting them steal the third too
cut away from in front of stumps, gets a single to deep point
dances down the track, is not quite to the pitch of the ball, ends up dragging an intended straight shot to midwicket
angled into the pads, worked away for a single
length ball, smacked down the ground to long-on for one
pushes one fullish delivery down to long-on for one
driven down to long-off, takes a single
and again he looks to sweep, again he gets way across outside off, and again Punjab belt out a horrendous shout
short, cut to short third for one
looks to sweep first up, misses but makes sure he gets outside the line
drags this from outside off to long-on for one
and the first ball is a pie, half way down the pitch, and Kohli pulls it to midwicket boundary
into the pads, worked around the corner
gives him the charge and flicks this from outside off to the on side for one
looks to work it to leg and gets a leading edge, one bounce to cover
flat, cramping him up, hit straight to mid-off
looks for the ugly swipe into the on side, gets a leading edge to short third - on the bounce
big appeal for caught behind! Actually Bisla thinks it is out and doesn't bother looking at the umpire. Kohli looks to defend this but the ball goes with the arm and through to Bisla off the pad
looks for the big hit into the on side but ends up yorking himself up
full outside off, smartly bunted into the on side, between long-on and deep midwicket. No man inside the circle means he can come back for two
short and wide, cut away, deep point is in position
full, driven to sweeper-cover for one
flat! incredible hit! When he hit it down the ground, it seemed it would be a comfortable catch for mid-off, but it kept travelling, defeating gravity for that extra split-second
flighted wide outside off, hit down the ground for one

and immediately there is action! KP drills a short ball back at Sharma who misses the catch but gets a deflection onto the non-striker's stumps to find Pandey backing up and not back in. Freak dismissal
angled into the pads, pushed down to long-on for another single
short outside off, hit to long-off for one
flighted this time, and played into covers for one
again flat, his height creating an awkward sort of angle, beats Pandey, the lbw shout is turned down as this might be headed down leg
flat outside off, hit to point
long hop, sits up, asking - nay begging - to be hit, and KP pulls it over midwicket
flighted on the pads, flicked straight to midwicket
still on the shorter side but not short enough, Pandey tries the same shot but can't beat mid-on
too short, and Pandey flat-bats it between mid-off and extra cover unorthodox but effective
straighter and flatter, helped away to short third for one
legbreak pitched on a length, guided past cover for one
catches him on the front foot with a bouncer, no room either and the top edge goes flying over the keeper
short, into the ribs, pulled away to deep square leg
nicely guided to square of third man to come back for two
looks to whip this off the stumps, gets an inside edge onto the pad
superb shot first ball! moves across and uses his wrists to drive it straight of mid-off, from wide of off
out first ball, Kallis looks for the big booming drive through the off side, ends up going too hard and edges a straight angling delivery
short, looks to cut, gets the bottom part of the bat, one bounce to the keeper
slower ball, picks it up early, and lofts it cleanly over mid-off
shorter, outside off, steered away to third man
unlucky Sree, Kallis gives him the charge and Sree cramps him up and the inside edge beats both the stumps and short fine leg
yorker, hit back to Sree, it deflects off his hand to get him in the ankle
makes room for the square drive, doesn't connect well, finds cover
slower short delivery again, and it's so slow he pulls out of the pull shot and runs it down to third man
slower bouncer this time, awkwardly pulled wide of mid-on for one
Yuvi nearly pulls off a stunner, the slower ball gets Pandey who lofts it tyowards midwicket, Yuvraj rushes off from mid-on and after covering lots of ground, doesn't get the dive right
wide yorker, beats him
short, and pulled away nicely in front of square, from outside off, didn't look to hit too hard, just time it
full on the pads, worked away into the leg side
overpitched, but Sree does a nice job fielding in his follow through, and hits the leg stump direct too
slight swing there, Pandey plays away from the body, and is duly beaten
runs this one from in front of off to third man for one
Kallis sets himself up for the pull, but Sreesanth is too sharp for it and beats him
slower ball, obvious legcutter, hit straight to left of mid-on, and Sreesanth has over-stepped
straying into the pads, and worked away square of fine leg for two
starts well, back of a length, no room, pushed to point
length ball again, and pushed to mid-off for one
length ball pushed straight of long-on for a single
slower ball, bunted to point for a single
short into the hips, and Irfan's misfield at square leg costs them two runs
full and swing there, , Pandey tries to make room but gets too outside the line
starts with the sort delivery, tucking him up, 139ks, patted to leg side
